title: Some people think they’ve gone too far.
paragraphs: Some people think they’ve gone too far.

Too many sins.
Too many mistakes.
Too many years running from God.
But Jesus told a story that destroys that lie.

A son wasted everything — his inheritance, his dignity, his future.
He ended up feeding pigs… starving… broken.
Yet the moment he turned toward home…

Not with anger.
Not with rejection.
This is the heart of God.
No matter how far someone runs, grace runs farther.

Question:
Do you think the Prodigal Son story is really about the younger son… or the father’s love?
